title: Prediction collapse in frozen encoder classifiers: code and aggregate results
description: Clean review release of 2026 experiment code, aggregate results, scientific figures and verification tools. Manuscripts, experiment-plan files, raw datasets, per-example records, embeddings, learned weights and private Git history are excluded. Checkpoint/decision-rule/target evaluations are not independent replications. Monant is a separate claim/article stance task. The reviewed code and aggregate-results release is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23445417.
